description: Terminator score profile across the ara transcript with the operon 3' terminator as positive control
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, json, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
p = "/agent/jobs/b3121cbc-4a4c-4f90-8982-3320a3dc8c81/provenance"
best = np.load(p+"/ara_terminator_profile.npy")
seq  = open(p+"/ara_locus_transcript_strand.txt").read().strip()
fr   = json.load(open(p+"/ara_locus_frame.json")); HI=fr["HI"]; gt=fr["gene_transcript_coords"]
v = best[~np.isnan(best)]; mu, sd = v.mean(), v.std(); thr = mu+4*sd

names=["araA","araB","araD","araL","araM","araN","araP","araQ","abfA"]
rows=[]
for a,b in zip(names[:-1],names[1:]):
    j=gt[a][1]; w=best[max(0,j-60):j+60]; w=w[~np.isnan(w)]
    rows.append(dict(window=f"{a}/{b}", kind="internal junction", best_score=round(float(w.max()),2),
                     z=round(float((w.max()-mu)/sd),2), exceeds_thr=bool(w.max()>thr)))
j=gt["abfA"][1]; w=best[j:j+400]; w=w[~np.isnan(w)]
rows.append(dict(window="downstream of abfA", kind="positive control (operon 3' end)",
                 best_score=round(float(w.max()),2), z=round(float((w.max()-mu)/sd),2), exceeds_thr=bool(w.max()>thr)))
w=best[0:gt["araA"][0]]; w=w[~np.isnan(w)]
rows.append(dict(window="5' flank upstream of araA", kind="positive control (flanking unit)",
                 best_score=round(float(w.max()),2), z=round(float((w.max()-mu)/sd),2), exceeds_thr=bool(w.max()>thr)))
tab=pd.DataFrame(rows); print(tab.to_string(index=False))
tab.to_csv(p+"/ara_terminator_junction_table.csv", index=False)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(13,5.2))
x = np.arange(len(best))
ax.plot(x, best, lw=0.5, color="#4a5568")
ax.axhline(thr, color="crimson", ls="--", lw=1)
ax.text(60, thr+0.5, "mean + 4 SD", color="crimson", fontsize=8)
ax.axhline(mu, color="grey", ls=":", lw=0.8)
cols = {"araM":"#c53030"}
for g in names:
    a,b = gt[g]
    ax.axvspan(a, b, color=cols.get(g,"#dbeafe"), alpha=0.5 if g!="araM" else 0.35, lw=0)
    ax.text((a+b)/2, -2.2, g, ha="center", fontsize=8,
            fontweight="bold" if g=="araM" else "normal", color="#c53030" if g=="araM" else "k")
for t, lab in [(10879,"operon terminator\n9 nt after abfA stop\nscore 27.8, z = 5.1"),
               (151,"terminator of the\nupstream unit\nscore 27.4, z = 5.0")]:
    ax.annotate(lab, xy=(t,best[t]), xytext=(t+(-1700 if t>5000 else 500), 33),
                fontsize=7.5, ha="center", arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=0.8))
for g,lab in [("araL","araL/araM\nz = 1.5"),("araM","araM/araN\nz = 2.0")]:
    j=gt[g][1]
    ax.annotate(lab, xy=(j, best[j] if not np.isnan(best[j]) else mu), xytext=(j, 31),
                fontsize=7.5, ha="center", color="#c53030",
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=0.8, color="#c53030"))
ax.set_ylim(-4, 38); ax.set_xlim(0, len(best))
ax.set_xlabel("position along the ara transcript (nt, 5' to 3'; genome 2,949,200 down to 2,937,800 on the minus strand)")
ax.set_ylabel("intrinsic terminator score")
ax.set_title("No intrinsic terminator flanks araM: the only strong hairpin-plus-U-tract signals\n"
             "in the ara locus are the operon 3' terminator and the terminator of the upstream unit", fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
